scope: Repeated-use inner development only; outer diagnostic scores do not choose settings. Outer Known train pool inner partitions must not be reused as independent selection for every Joint fold.
prior: Per inner and seed: train-only population 3 starts x 120 steps; molecular prior 120 fixed epochs; relation OFF; frozen for all adaptations.
gru_loss: Hierarchical weighted future query log MSE + .001 parameter offset penalty. Original support, k=0/1/2/4. No contrast, no FiLM; shared frozen prior.
state_semantics: GRU retains propagated amounts at each parameter update and optionally assimilates central amount at each support. MAP reconstructs a single trajectory and estimates first-support central state. These are explicitly distinct mechanisms.
selection: For each family select common epoch or strength across 2 inners x 3 seeds by worst mean prior-relative track ratio; then mean ratio; then earliest epoch or strongest strength. Include exact prior overall. Report validation selection optimism.
query: Same queries after fourth distinct time block for every k.
restricted_candidate: Not introduced in this phase; prioritize trained parameter/state separation and existing strong fixed MAP controls.
